title: MathShow Hub Art-1 Batch 5: Lake, Terraces, Holo, Glyph Visuals
acceptance: PineTree (<=150 tris, untextured, ~14 studs) generated with at most 3 generate_mesh calls, every asset id in manifest.json, candidates screenshotted at 844x390 and picked by jg; exported from a Studio scratch place.
Lake: flat Glass Part (Lake Ink, Reflectance ~0.6, CanCollide false) over a collidable lakebed below the water; promenade railing with Lamp Amber Neon top rail; up to 2 reused LampPosts.
Terraces and boundary: Slate Teal walls with SmoothPlastic grass-top slabs, <=60 PineTree instances; boundary walls stay collidable and gap-free (collider guard and wall-overlap check pass).

Holo symbols: BillboardGui TextLabels (pi, sigma, root, plus, minus, times, divide), LightInfluence 0, >=25 studs above any walkable surface, <=8 visible from any spawn-area view, bob/spin through HubCosmetics (pcall-isolated, one RenderStepped connection); no GlyphSpawn tags.

Glyph visuals (client cosmetic only): chest-height Neon math-symbol billboard with a soft sparkle ParticleEmitter (default texture), distinct from the holos; pickup burst pcall-isolated; no change to collection, retry, server or remotes.
Budgets: <=4 new PointLights (hub <=27), <=700 new instances, <=25k new triangles, ParticleEmitters <=34 with Rate <=6.

Regression at a clean BuildStamp: walk times 8-12 s, 34/34 reachable, 6 pads, mid-match block, Glyph collect (common and rare), reject-retry, respawn, HUD, console clean, cannot stand in the lake or leave the map.
Evidence in docs/workflow/evidence/TASK-0132/art-lake.txt (measured SHA, applies_to); A1-framing and aerial screenshots; brief light total updated.
notes: Approved rows L0-L8 (jg, 2026-11-02). Out of scope: skybox, polish items (violet hue, A2 portal frame, A3 L-hall, telescope tip), audio, Lighting.Technology, saving the place, merging. Do not record-audit or self-audit.
